verdict.rationale: Brex documents spend limits with auto-enforced controls, per-transaction limits on vendor-specific cards, and monthly user limits plus virtual cards with resetting limits, set via the Team, Budgets and Pipedream integrations. That covers per-card and per-employee limit-setting. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the granular control types (e.g., merchant/category restrictions, per-employee policy rules), and independent or hands-on corroboration that per-employee card controls work as described.
